notes: ACCESS: browser-only via Chrome tab, robots.txt checked first (no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow entries, only generic crawl-delay and standard directory disallows) - proceeded. TREE METHOD: union of top mega-menu (Living, Bedroom, Dining, Rugs, Decor, Outdoor - full nav set, confirmed via hover-revealed dropdowns and read_page) plus each category landing page's own sub-nav/breadcrumb. XML sitemap route (interiordefine.com/sitemap/sitemap.xml) is intercepted by the site's own SPA client-side router and never renders raw XML (infinite loading spinner on an unmapped route) - not a bot block, just app behavior; mega-menu + category sub-nav union used as the authoritative tree instead, which is sufficient since this is a small curated furniture brand (not a large multi-thousand-SKU catalog). QTY METHOD: rendered 'N results' header text on each category listing page (e.g. 'Medium Rugs ... 74 results'). EXCLUDED: Living (Sectionals incl. Storage sectionals, Sofas, Chairs, Tables) = Furniture, not Storage - a sectional with a storage compartment is still primarily a sofa/furniture product per storage.md Furniture Boundary. Bedroom (Beds, Nightstands, Seating, Mattresses) = Furniture. Dining (chairs/stools, benches, tables) = Furniture. Outdoor (single 14-result listing, no subcategories) = outdoor furniture (lounge/seating), not textile/storage. Decor > Lighting = Lighting category (out of scope). Decor > Artwork = Wall Decor (out of scope). Decor (parent, 136 results) skipped per parent-URL rule since valid subcategories (Pillows/Lighting/Artwork) exist. Rugs (parent /rugs, has valid subcategories) skipped per parent-URL rule; rug-pads (/rugs/rug-pads) excluded as a functional accessory, not a textile/fabric product category per either ruleset's include lists. No Storage category, no storage boxes/baskets/organizers/racks/shelving found anywhere in the site navigation - Interior Define is a made-to-order furniture + rugs + pillows + lighting + wall art brand with no dedicated storage/organization product line, so storage_rows is empty (NO_CATEGORY for Storage).
